title: Release workflow and GitHub Pages site
summary: Adds the release workflow that builds and attaches the Windows and Mac installers when a version is published, and the download site with its Pages workflow, held off until Pages is switched on; checkouts no longer leave the write token on disk.
friction: Under four parallel worktrees the full suite timed out twice in tests this run did not touch (an agents-feature test, the store's real-process tests); each passed alone and on the rerun, so a loaded machine can show a false red that costs a dev round to rule out

deferred.what: `mac.target` names no arch and the Mac runner is Apple silicon, so the site's Mac download is an arm64 dmg that does not run on Intel Macs
deferred.why: Arch choice and cross-building native modules belong to the packaging config, outside this story's seam
